name: Text Diff
summary: Compare two texts with inline word highlights or side-by-side lines — entirely in your browser.
description: Paste original and modified text to see additions, deletions, and unchanged lines. Switch between inline (word-level highlights on changed lines) and classic side-by-side views. Export a unified diff to the clipboard.

faqs.question: Inline vs side-by-side?
faqs.answer: Inline shows a single stream with +/-/~ markers and word-level highlights on replaced lines. Side-by-side shows original and modified columns.

faqs.question: Is this character-level or line-level?
faqs.answer: Matching is line-level. Replaced lines also get a word-level highlight pass in inline mode.

faqs.question: Does my text get uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Diffing runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: What is the unified diff copy?
faqs.answer: A classic +/- format you can paste into chats, tickets, or patches.
